evidence: A formal PetUp/petup.lua exists in both data and hydata; the data and hydata formal files are distinct endpoint blobs but share the same core structure.
The residue petup1.lua~ has executable ABLua NPC logic and its own main() creating an NPC named 二代宠物进化.
The residue creates the same NPC name and metamo 110119 as formal petup.lua, but at 2005,(23,1) instead of the formal 2005,(18,21), indicating a materially different deployment/version placement.
The residue adds a distinct pet exterior-switch flow while retaining complete-evolution handling; it therefore cannot be treated as a byte-identical backup of petup.lua.
No repository-side exact loader entry selecting petup1.lua~ was found.

Public ABLua material corroborates that main() is the startup entry and CreateNpc/setFunctionPointer is the normal NPC creation/binding pattern, but it does not prove this residue was selected by the RO0000 build.
The 37,329-byte, 774-line payload contains a complete Ten Halls challenge flow, including battle-over progression, floor transitions, reward handling, and the shualou command registration in main().

A formal counterpart exists at data/ablua/npc/YamaKing/YamaKing.lua, but it is in the data tree rather than the residue's hydata tree; the blobs differ (residue bbc0dac6ca2b4a61a075b3de0625bdab55a03b71; data counterpart 5ce8f4ce790487c25bb8cb35cf1d830e41554109).

The variants materially differ: cooldown 7200 vs 3600 seconds; base floor-point and random-point arrays differ; TM_FiveSlow is 10 vs 6; TM_DoubleUp is 4 vs 0; the residue gates startup on gameserver name '娱乐互动线' and creates six floor NPCs, while the data counterpart gates on gameserver ID 1 and creates five.

The residue is under hydata/data/ablua/npc; endpoint setup.cf says npcdir=data/npc. No exact endpoint loader/binding selecting this specific residue was found in the repository, so its runtime eligibility is not established.

175sa.sql contains a yamakinginfo table with point and award-flag fields, but the snapshot does not by itself prove that this residue version is bound to that table. External exact-name/unique-setting searches did not produce authoritative loader or version provenance.
entries.action: preserve; retain as a distinct endpoint variant; require exact loader/binding and version provenance before runtime admission
